name: Achieve Supreme Influence
text: Control 4 planets outside your home system with more influence than resources.

name: Adapt New Strategies
text: Own 2 faction technologies. "Valefar Assimilator" technologies do not count toward this objective.

name: Advance Weaponry
text: Own unit upgrade technologies with combined prerequisites that include each color.

name: Allow Others A Voice
text: After the second agenda of the agenda phase is resolved, have more influence on readied planets than any other player.

name: Amass Forces
text: Have at least 10 units in each of 4 systems.

name: Assemble a Swarm
text: Have 20 fighters on the game board.

name: Attain Resource Supremacy
text: Control 4 planets outside your home system with more resources than influence.

name: Balance Imperial Interests
text: Control planets that have a combined value of at least 9 resources and at least 9 influence.

name: Battle Before the Unknown
text: Win a combat in a system that contains a wormhole.

name: Brave Hazards
text: Control a hazardous planet adjacent to another player's home system. (Planets adjacent to the Creuss Gate or the Sorrow count as adjacent to those factions' home systems.)

name: Build a Wonder
text: Have 3 structures in a non-home system.

name: Build Transport Network
text: Have a unit with capacity in each of 5 systems.

name: Check and Balance
text: Win a combat against the speaker.

name: Colonize Distant Stars
text: Control a planet in each of 3 systems that are not in or adjacent to your home system.

name: Come. See. Conquer.
text: Win more than 1 ground combat in a system during the same tactical action.

name: Connect The Cosmos
text: Have a unit in each of 2 different systems that contain a wormhole of the same type.

name: Decimation
text: Win a space combat in the first round of combat where your opponent did not successfully execute a retreat.

name: Decisive Legislation
text: Vote for an outcome that receives at least 10 more votes than any other outcome.

name: Defend Infrastructure
text: Have 9 infantry on each of 2 planets that contain a structure.

name: Destroy Research Vessels
text: Win a space combat against a player with the most technologies.

name: Develop The Ultimate Weapon
text: Own War Sun technology.

name: Diversify Approaches
text: Have at least 1 space dock in a system with an industrial planet, at least 2 PDS on cultural planets, and at least 1 mech on a hazardous planet.

name: Diversify Fleets
text: Have 5 different types of non-fighter ships in a system.

name: Diversify Holdings
text: Control 2 cultural, industrial, and hazardous planets.

name: Diversify Outposts
text: Control 3 technology specialty planets of different colors.

name: Dominate Cities
text: Have non-fighter ships in 5 systems that contain a structure.

name: Dominate Culture
text: Control a cultural planet adjacent to another player's home system. (Planets adjacent to the Creuss Gate or the Sorrow count as adjacent to those factions' home systems.)

name: Domineer
text: Have ships in 4 systems that contain a PDS.

name: Expand Reach
text: Have at least 1 ship in each of 3 systems that are not in or adjacent to your home system.

name: Field Test Advancements
text: Win a combat in which 2 of your surviving units are of different unit types whose unit upgrades you own.

name: Focus Advancements
text: Control 2 planets with the same technology specialty.

name: Forge Daring Culture
text: Control 3 hazardous planets and 2 cultural planets.

name: Forgive Debts
text: Return 3 promissory notes from your hand to the hands of their original owners.

name: Form a Contact Network
text: Control 4 planets outside of your home system that each have an influence value of 2 or higher.

name: Form the Heart of a New Empire
text: Control a planet in a system that is adjacent to 6 systems that contain your units.

name: Fortify Riches
text: Have a structure on each of 3 planets with at least 2 resources.

name: Fuel Industrial Machine
text: Control 3 industrial planets and 2 hazardous planets.

name: Fuel War Machine
text: Have 3 space docks on the game board.

name: Gather Abundance
text: Control 4 planets outside of your home system that each have a resource value of 2 or higher.

name: Heavy Artillery
text: Have 12 units on the game board with any combination of BOMBARDMENT, SPACE CANNON, or ANTI-FIGHTER BARRAGE.

name: Industrialize Culture
text: Control 3 cultural planets and 2 industrial planets.

name: Learn from Others
text: Fulfill the requirements to score 2 secret objectives other players have scored.

name: Learn the Cosmos' Secrets
text: Have 1 or more units in 4 systems that are each in or adjacent to an anomaly.

name: Leverage Soft Power
text: Have 2 or less promissory notes in your hand.

name: Master Archaeology
text: Have 2 or more relics.

name: Master Biotics
text: Control a green technology specialty planet, 2 green technologies, and at least 1 unit upgrade technology with at least 1 green prerequisite.

name: Master Cybernetics
text: Control a yellow technology specialty planet, 2 yellow technologies, and at least 1 unit upgrade technology with at least 1 yellow prerequisite.

name: Master Negotiation
text: Have at least 10 promissory notes in your hand.

name: Master Propulsion
text: Control a blue technology specialty planet, 2 blue technologies, and at least 1 unit upgrade technology with at least 1 blue prerequisite.

name: Master Warfare
text: Control a red technology specialty planet, 2 red technologies, and at least 1 unit upgrade technology with at least 1 red prerequisite.

name: Mine Rare Minerals
text: Control 4 hazardous planets.

name: No Witnesses
text: Win a space combat in a system that contains no planets.

name: Overpowering Defense
text: Have at least 7 units on the game board with SUSTAIN DAMAGE.

name: Overrun Defenses
text: Win a ground combat on a planet that contained another player's PDS at the start of the combat.

name: Prioritize Speed
text: Have 8 cruisers on the game board.

name: Punish Heretics
text: Win a combat against a player with the most relics; minimum 1.

name: Punish the Weak
text: Win a combat against a player with the least victory points.

name: Rebel Against Political Elites
text: Win a combat against a player that owns an elect player law.

name: Recruit A Large Army
text: Have 20 infantry on the game board.

name: Selective Arsenal
text: Have none of 2 different unit types in your reinforcements for which at least 1 of your neighbors owns the unit upgrade technology.

name: Settle Spacetime's Edge
text: Control 3 planets that are each in or adjacent to a system containing a wormhole.

name: Settle the Frontier
text: Control 4 planets that are in or adjacent to an anomaly.

name: Show of Strength
text: Have at least 1 ship in each of 2 systems that contain a planet another player controls.

name: Show the Council Your Strength
text: Win a combat in the Mecatol Rex system.

name: Spare No Munitions
text: After your opponent assigns hits, have 3 hits left unassigned.

name: Spread Influence
text: Have 1 or more units in each of at least 8 systems.

name: Strategic Encroachment
text: Control a planet with an attachment adjacent to another player's home system. (Planets adjacent to the Creuss Gate or the Sorrow count as adjacent to those factions' home systems.)

name: Structure Dominance
text: Win a combat against a player that has the most structures on the board.

name: Study the Symbols
text: Have a unit in or adjacent to at least 3 systems that contain a legendary planet or Mecatol Rex.

name: Study Their Defenses
text: Have ships in each of 2 systems that are in or adjacent to systems that contain other player's PDS.

name: Study Their Supply Chain
text: Have ships in each of 2 systems that are in or adjacent to systems that contain other player's space docks.

name: Suffer Slings and Arrows
text: Have 3 damaged units at the end of a combat you won.

name: Support the Weak
text: Have 1 of your promissory notes in the play area of a player with the least victory points.

name: Surprise Your Enemies
text: Win a combat against a player who has passed.

name: Tactical Fatigue
text: Have at least 5 exhausted non-planet, non-strategy cards in your play area.

name: Take Influential Strongholds
text: Have a structure on each of 3 planets with at least 2 influence.

name: Take Their Minerals
text: Win a ground combat on a hazardous planet.

name: Target Powerful Ships
text: Destroy 2 of your opponents units with SUSTAIN DAMAGE in the same round of combat.

name: Technological Exhaustion
text: Exhaust 3 of your technologies that have an ability that exhausts that card.

name: Toppling the Leader
text: Win a combat against a player with the highest initiative in a home system, a system that contains Mecatol Rex, or a system that contains a legendary planet.

name: Undercut Their Industry
text: Win a ground combat on an industrial planet.

name: Undermine Their Culture
text: Win a ground combat on a cultural planet.

name: Unflappable Command
text: Have no command tokens in your reinforcements.

name: Unseat the False King
text: Take control of Mecatol Rex when it was controlled by another player.

name: Usurp Industrial Power
text: Control an industrial planet adjacent to another player's home system. (Planets adjacent to the Creuss Gate or the Sorrow count as adjacent to those factions' home systems.)

name: Weaken the Powerful
text: Win a combat against a player that controls the most planets.
